blind.description: A classic wooden bookcase/bookshelf filled with rows of books and a small two-door lower cabinet. The unit features an ornate decorative crown moulding at the top, side columns/pilasters with carved bases and capitals, multiple shelves stocked with multi-colored books (red, green, gold/brown, orange), and a flat wooden panel back. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with stylized hand-painted wood and book textures. It stands flat on its integrated base.
blind.from_above: A rectangular brown top surface with forward-projecting corner cornices creating a wide shallow bracket or C-shape along the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.2 to 1.3 times the height of the figure (about 7 to 7.5 feet tall) and about half the figure's height in width (around 3 feet wide).
